subject: world_language
concept: Introducing yourself: saying your name in the target language
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR A1 'introduce self' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student practices introducing themselves aloud to the persona using the target-language phrase
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a self-introduction phrase to a picture of someone pointing to themselves
exercise.abstract: Student writes or says a self-introduction sentence in the target language

misconception_flags: confuses 'my name is' structure with asking someone else's name

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
